window: 4 AM Mon 2 Nov to 4 AM Tue 3 Nov IST
headline: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana led yesterday with 110K tickets booked, while Aadarsha Kutumbam had the biggest drop at down 71%.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana ranked first with 110K tickets booked, up 27% on the day before (86.6K).
Aadarsha Kutumbam was second at 50.3K, down 71% from 175K, and was the biggest mover of the day.
Jailer 2 (42.1K, down 69%) and Udta Teer (28.1K, down 52%) also fell, and no film rose in the rankings.
Scene gained 30K interested users in 24 hours to reach 223K+, ahead of its Fri 6 Nov release.
The Cat in the Hat opened bookings for its Nov 06, 2026 release in English and Hindi.
